_help: Copy to annotator_config.json (same dir, or the dir you launch from) and edit. CLI flags override these. Relative 'roots' resolve against the repo root (photo_processing/). Any key may be omitted to keep its default.
_help_agreement: Inter-annotator agreement. replicate_pct is the share of scenes (chosen by a stable hash of the scene id, so the sample never reshuffles) served to replicates_per_scene different people. A replicate scene is served BLIND: anyone who has not labeled it yet gets it with water_mask.png hidden, so the second opinion is independent. Every save also keeps a per-annotator copy in work/masks/<scene-id>/. Score it with photo_processing/agreement.py. 0 disables.
_help_device: auto | cpu | cuda | cuda:0 | mps | xpu (also aliases amd/rocm -> cuda, intel -> xpu). Default for the torch/ultralytics backends (sam, sam2, segformer) and the fine-tune trainer. 'auto' = CUDA/ROCm if present, else Intel xpu, else Apple mps, else cpu. AMD GPUs: install a ROCm build of torch (it still reports as 'cuda'); for the Radeon 780M / gfx1103 also set env HSA_OVERRIDE_GFX_VERSION=11.0.0 (see README 'Integrated AMD Radeon'). If a GPU is present but torch can't use it, the startup banner and /api/config device_hint say so and the app stays on CPU. ONNX GPU inference picks up whichever provider your onnxruntime build exposes: onnxruntime-gpu (CUDA), onnxruntime-rocm (AMD), onnxruntime-directml (Windows).

backends._help_tinysam: Fully external: needs a TinySAM checkout AND a driver script, neither of which ships here. Unset, the backend just shows as unavailable.
